requirements.description: The system must provide a home page for user input.
The system must offer navigation to the main functionalities for owners and veterinarians.
The system must allow registering guardians with name, surname, address, city and telephone number.
The system must allow changing the data of an already registered tutor.
The system should allow you to consult tutors based on the beginning of the last name entered.
The system must allow extensive consultation of tutors when no surname is provided.
The system must direct directly to the tutor's detailed registration when the search returns only one result.
The system must present a paginated list when the search returns several tutors.
The system should inform the user when no tutor matches are found.
The system must display the complete data of the selected tutor.
The system must allow registering an animal linked to a guardian.
The system must allow changing the data of an already registered animal.
The system must record, for each animal, name, type and date of birth.
The system must provide a pre-defined list of animal types for selection.
The system must prevent the same owner from owning two animals with the same name.
The system must prevent the registration of a future date of birth for the animal.
The system must allow recording a visit for a specific animal.
The visit record must contain, at a minimum, the date and description of the service.
The system must suggest the current date as the starting value for a new visit.
The system must associate the registered visit with the history of the animal and its owner.
The system must display the visit history of animals linked to the owner.
The system must list registered veterinarians with their names and specialties.
The system must inform the next scheduled visit for each veterinarian.
The system must present the list of veterinarians in a paged form.
The system should automatically assign each new visit to a veterinarian.
Automatic assignment should prioritize the veterinarian with the lowest burden of future care.
The system must periodically disregard past visit assignments when calculating the veterinarians' workload.
The system must make the list of veterinarians available in a structured format for consumption by other systems.
: Usability (Operability). The system must have a simple web interface, with easy-to-understand forms and navigation.
The system must present clear success, error and validation messages.
The system must be usable on different screen sizes, such as computer and cell phone.
The system must support multiple interface languages.
Messages and labels must maintain consistency across supported languages.
The system must validate mandatory data before making registrations and changes.
The system must display understandable error pages for known and unexpected failures.
The visit record must remain consistent even when distribution to the veterinarian occurs in a separate stage.
The system must resume pending internal processing after restart, avoiding loss of relevant events.
The system must not allow the direct change of internal identifiers through forms.
Frequent veterinary consultations should be optimized to reduce response time.
Static interface resources must be able to be temporarily reused by the browser to improve loading.
The system must support growth in the volume of owners and veterinarians without compromising basic navigation, using pagination.
The system must be able to operate with different data storage configurations.
The system must be organized in a way that facilitates the isolated evolution of the areas of guardians, veterinarians and general functions.
The system's main behaviors must be capable of verification by automated tests.
